data.text: Forest cover declined by 15% in the region between 2010 and 2020 due to deforestation.
Agricultural land was converted to urban areas during the study period.
Wetlands decreased significantly from 2005 to 2015 in the coastal region.
Built-up area increased from 52.88% in 2002 to 65.5% in 2018.
Grassland area showed a substantial decline over the past decade.
